messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — onboarding POC for Solano (large mid‑market finance SaaS). They want to migrate off their current vendor and need compatibility with their existing API surface. Main asks: prompt/response parity, identical error codes, signed request headers, rate-limit mapping, and a short security questionnaire. Also they asked for a POC pricing alignment for 3 months. Can eng/security/solutions weigh in? @nick @tara @sam

nick: Thanks — can you paste the customer API spec and a couple of sample prompt/response pairs? Helpful to see where outputs diverge today.

maria: Sent the spec in DM. Two quick examples below. Note they rely on `choices[0].text` and expect 400/429 codes exactly.

maria: ```json
{"prompt":"Summarize transaction history for acct 42","response":"Last three transactions: ...","status":200}
```

maria: ```json
{"prompt":"Explain failed transfer","response":"Insufficient funds","status":400}
```

tara: ML note: parity often fails because of tokenization and sampling differences. If you need exact text match we should consider deterministic decoding + same tokenizer & temp=0 for the POC. I can run a seed set (100 prompts) and compute delta metrics (BLEU / exact-match / length). Expect ~60–80% exact match baseline vs their model unless we force deterministic settings.

lee: From solutions side — we can implement a lightweight compatibility proxy that rewrites their API fields to Redwood's and back. Rough mapping:
```
// incoming Solano -> Redwood
POST /v1/generate  ->  POST /v1/completions
body.prompt        ->  body.input
client_key header  ->  Authorization: Bearer <token>
status 400/429     ->  pass-through with same codes
```
I'll prototype a shim (node) and run it in our staging. That should handle header translation + backoff header mapping.

nick: Important: they require exact 429 semantics (Retry-After). Our hosted product returns 429 with Retry-After already, but dedicated/private behavior differs depending on autoscale. We'll need to guarantee the header for POC — recommend Dedicated reserved pool for POC or we write the shim to synthesize identical Retry-After behavior.

sam: Security checklist: they care about KMS BYOK, data residency (EU), and an audit trail for every request. We support AWS KMS and HSM integrations on Private, and we can provide customer-managed keys for Dedicated with a SOC2 compliant audit trail. I'll take the SSQ — please hand over the questionnaire PDF.

maria: Dropped SSQ in thread (solano_ssq_v2.pdf). Any blockers on our side for BYOK and EU residency?

sam: No blockers technically. For hosted we can’t do customer BYOK; Dedicated or Private is required. If they insist on hosted with BYOK, we'd need a private control plane deployment (timeline ~6 weeks). For the POC timeline (4 weeks) we should plan Dedicated or a staging Private cluster.

lee: POC pricing idea: offer a 3‑month discounted committed Dedicated package — 30% off list for the first 3 months, include up to 500M tokens of ingress free, and waive premium observability charges during the POC. That gives them a cost floor to compare against their current vendor. @maria can you confirm procurement constraints?

maria: Procurement will need a simple SOW. Also they asked about token accounting parity (how we count tokens vs their vendor). Any differences?

tara: Tokenization differences are real (model tokenizer differences). For fairness, we can run token accounting on their sample corpus with our tokenizer and provide a per-prompt token delta report. For billing parity during POC, we can invoice by effective output tokens (or agree to a capped token invoice) to remove disputes.

nick: Next steps I propose: 1) Lee builds the shim and deploys to staging (ETA 3 business days). 2) Tara runs parity tests on 1000 seed prompts (ETA 5 days). 3) Sam completes SSQ answers (ETA 2 days). 4) Sales legal drafts a 3-month SOW with the POC pricing offer. If we hit >90% parity, proceed to pilot; if not, we’ll document gaps and recommend tokenization / deterministic settings.

maria: Sounds good. Please add any smaller asks into this thread so I can triage with the AE.

deploy-bot: canary-deploy: staging/compat-shim started by lee — build 487f1 — tail logs at https://deploys.internal/487f1

lee: I'll attach the shim repo link and an initial patch for the status code passthrough shortly.

maria: great — thanks all :thumbsup:
